method: Group stems by exact file hash, identical pixels, visually identical dhash (hamming 0), and same plate-id prefix after stripping trailing parenthetical suffixes. Sort groups by first stem, shuffle groups with random.Random(42), flatten, cut 2122/455/455, then keep each group in one split and rebalance using singleton stems only. Different plates with close dhash are not merged.
identifier: filename stem; pair with images/<stem>.jpg, labels/<stem>.json, masks/<stem>.png
